import json, shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path

print("python:", sys.version.split()[0])
inp = Path("/kaggle/input")
print("input exists:", inp.is_dir(), "children:", sorted(p.name for p in inp.iterdir()) if inp.is_dir() else None)

for p in sorted(inp.rglob("*")):
    rel = p.relative_to(inp)
    if len(rel.parts) <= 3:
        print(f"  {'d' if p.is_dir() else 'f'} {rel}" + ("" if p.is_dir() else f" {p.stat().st_size}"))

mats = sorted(inp.rglob("*.mat"))
print("n_mat:", len(mats))
for p in mats[:2]:
    print("  first:", p, p.stat().st_size)
for p in mats[-2:]:
    print("  last :", p, p.stat().st_size)

print("working free GiB:", round(shutil.disk_usage("/kaggle/working").free / 2**30, 2))

import torch
print("torch", torch.__version__, "cuda", torch.cuda.is_available())
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    print("device", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0), torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0))

if mats:
    from scipy.io import loadmat
    d = loadmat(str(mats[0]), variable_names=["emg", "restimulus"], squeeze_me=False)
    print("emg", d["emg"].shape, d["emg"].dtype, "restimulus", d["restimulus"].shape)
